transcript.content: Hello, it’s nice to meet you. What brings you in today?

Nice to meet you too. Um, I came in because... well, I just can't stop thinking that the left side of my face looks really off. Like, my nose and my jaw just look crooked. I see it every time I look at an ID photo or when my camera is on for my online classes. 

People tell me they don't see it, but... I just feel like everyone in the CNC lab at work is noticing my face before they even notice my work. It's just really getting to me.
How certain are you that your face is actually crooked, despite what other people tell you?

I mean... I'm completely certain. I know people say they don't see it, but I just think they're being nice, or maybe they just aren't looking that closely. But I see it. It's right there every time I look at a screen or a picture. So, yeah, I'm... I'm a hundred percent sure it's crooked, no matter what anyone else says.
When you worry about your face looking crooked, do you repeatedly check it in mirrors, photos, or cameras?

Yeah, I do. Um, especially right before I leave for school. I just get stuck checking my face in the bathroom mirror, and then I'll pull out my phone camera to check it there, too. I'll spend a lot of time trying to fix my hair or changing my shirt, just trying to find something that hides the angle better. I'll even ask my mom repeatedly if it looks weird. 

Honestly, sometimes I get so caught up doing all that... checking and trying to fix it... that I end up doing it for so long I actually miss my lab. Or by the time I finally get there, I'm just too wiped out to even focus on my work.
Is there any part of you that can consider the possibility that your face is not actually crooked, or are you completely convinced that it is?

Um, like I said just a minute ago, I'm completely convinced that it is. I know you're asking if I have any doubts about it, but... no, I really don't. When I look at myself, it's just obviously crooked to me. So, no, there really isn't any part of me that can entertain the idea that it's normal.
What worries you most about your face being crooked: how it looks, or that it means something else is physically wrong with you?

I mean, it's definitely just how it looks. I haven't really ever thought about it meaning something else is physically wrong with me, like a medical issue or whatever. It's just... I just hate how noticeable and bad it looks. That's really the only thing I'm worried about.
